messages:
nina: quick follow-up from the quant RFC meeting earlier — we need a short ops handoff checklist for FP8/INT8/4-bit rollouts. thinking a minimal playbook + telemetry knobs.
arjun: agreed. main concerns: silent quality regressions and noisy canaries. want a compact set of signals we can ship with profiles.
sam: +1. my suggested signals: 1) token-level perplexity delta 2) frequent token drift rate 3) latency p95 change 4) cohort-level exact-match on anchor prompts
maria: can we also add a compact shadow-sample for 0.5% of traffic? that helps catch headwise failures without full perf hit.
nina: yes — shadow sampling sounds good. ops constraints: we want <2% perf overhead and clear auto-fallback thresholds.
arjun: fallback policy proposal: if cohort EM drops >3% AND token-drift >0.02 for 5m -> revert to conservative profile. else if only latency regresses -> scale up batch size / fall through to INT8.
sam: minor note: batching fixes latency but can hide headwise artifacts. need per-prompt quality probes.
maria: here's a small telemetry snippet we can include in profiles for Ops to enable quickly:

```
quant_probe:
  probe_rate: 0.005           # 0.5% traffic
  anchor_prompts: ["short Q/A", "summarize 100w"]
  drift_threshold: 0.02
  em_drop_threshold: 0.03
  lookback_window_secs: 300
```

nina: nice. also add a safety-net short-circuit on hallucination spikes. maybe check n-gram surprise for URL/entity hallucinations.
arjun: ops playbook bullets (draft):
- enable quant_probe at 0.1% on staging -> validate for 24h
- run A/B shadow for 48h with exact-match anchors
- enable canary on 1% production; monitor EM, drift, lat p95
- if any two signals trip, auto-fail to baseline and page #eng-oncall
- record full kv-cache snapshot for the failing window

sam: can we automate the "record kv-cache snapshot" step via runtime flag to avoid manual intervention? ops-bot could stash to s3.
ops-bot: noted. runtime-flag `--stash-kv-on-trip` implemented in canary agent. requires agent=2.1.3.
maria: question — how do we version these profile configs? must be immutable with rollforward IDs so Dedicated customers can pin.
arjun: yes: profile_id + semantic version (e.g., p-123.v2). runtime will match on (profile_id, version). rollback is switching the version pointer.
nina: final ask: small markdown checklist for the customer-facing handoff doc. i'll draft and post to docs repo, tagging @sam for the runbook steps. anyone object to shipping this week?
sam: no objections. i'll take the runbook bullet expansion.
maria: i can prep the telemetry dashboard panels and a compact playbook card for console.
arjun: i'll wire the auto-fallback thresholds into the runtime config and run a local smoke.
ops-bot: deploy pipeline scheduled for 2025-09-12 02:00 UTC (canary agent bump + probe flag). :white_check_mark:
